sections.title: Acceptance of Terms
paragraphs: By accessing or using Amsirar Trip's website, reserving travel itineraries, or confirming private excursions in Morocco, you enter into a legally binding agreement governed by these Terms of Service.

If you do not accept these terms in their entirety, you should not access or make reservations through our services. Amsirar Trip reserves the right to update these terms to reflect changes in Moroccan legislation or company policy. Continued participation in our tours constitutes acceptance of any published modifications.

sections.title: Our Services & Tour Operations
paragraphs: Amsirar Trip provides tailor-made travel planning, Sahara desert expeditions, High Atlas mountain trekking, imperial city cultural journeys, and bespoke excursions across the Kingdom of Morocco.

All published tours are subject to availability and formal written confirmation. Route descriptions, photographs, and itineraries displayed on our platforms serve an illustrative purpose. Actual experiences, stops, and timings may adjust based on weather conditions, seasonal daylight, road closures, and passenger safety considerations.

sections.title: Booking, Deposit & Payment Schedule
paragraphs: To secure vehicle allocation, licensed driver scheduling, and desert camp lodging, all reservations require an advance confirmation deposit.

The remaining balance is due prior to departure or according to the explicit terms established during your booking confirmation. Quoted prices include only the specific inclusions enumerated in your official itinerary. Optional upgrades, gratuities, personal incidentals, and individual travel insurance are not included unless expressly invoiced.

callout.title: Transparent Pricing Guarantee
callout.desc: All quotations are fixed in the contracted currency upon deposit receipt. We never charge hidden tourist surcharges or unexpected booking fees.

sections.title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
paragraphs: We understand travel plans can shift unexpectedly. However, organizing private journeys across the Moroccan desert and mountains requires binding commitments with local Berber camps, nomadic hosts, and licensed transport providers.
Cancellations must be communicated in writing via email (amsirare@gmail.com) or official WhatsApp. Refund percentages apply strictly according to the departure timeline detailed in the matrix below.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability & Force Majeure
paragraphs: Amsirar Trip operates with utmost diligence, collaborating exclusively with licensed professional drivers, official local mountain guides, and vetted accommodation partners across Morocco.

To the maximum extent permitted under Moroccan law, Amsirar Trip shall not be held liable for damages, route modifications, or financial losses caused by events of Force Majeure (including severe weather, desert sandstorms, road damage, political disruptions, or border regulations beyond our reasonable control). Our total aggregate liability for any proven operational failure is strictly capped at the total booking amount paid.

sections.title: Intellectual Property & Content Rights
paragraphs: All proprietary content presented on amsirartrip.com (including written itineraries, destination guides, high-resolution photography, brand typography, and design elements) is protected under Moroccan and international intellectual property law.
No content, maps, or editorial text may be copied, repurposed, or republished for commercial tour operations without express prior written permission from Amsirar Trip SARL.

sections.title: Governing Law & Legal Jurisdiction
paragraphs: These Terms of Service, all passenger contracts, and any disputes arising out of your booking with Amsirar Trip are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Morocco.

In the event of any claim, disagreement, or controversy that cannot be resolved amicably through direct customer service mediation, the parties irrevocably submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent commercial courts of Marrakech, Morocco.
